name: Theatrhythm: Final Bar Line - NieR Pack Vol. 2
summary:
A pack of 6 additional music tracks from the NieR series to use with Theatrhythm Final Bar Line.

"Fleeting Words / Outsider", "Song of the Ancients / Devola", "Hills of Radiant Winds", "Kainé / Salvation", "Song of the Ancients / Fate" and "Shadowlord"
